structure.unit: Prisons and Other Methods of Correction
Treatment and Control of Prisoners Known to Be Pregnant

law.text: The warden or other official in charge of a state correctional facility shall compile a monthly summary of all written reports received pursuant to §§ 53.1-25.1, 53.1-40.12, and 53.1-40.13 and shall submit the summary to the Director each month.
